Yes, use straps for your heavy sets. If your back is the target and your grip quits first, the grip is capping the work you came to do. A common approach is chalk first, then straps only on the top sets or the last few reps, so your grip still gets trained on the lighter work.

Keep a bit of grip work in your week too, like heavy holds or farmer carries, so it catches up over time. A mixed grip (one palm each way) also helps, if you're not already using it.

If you want, I can look at your deadlift history and tell you where the grip is likely showing up.
